_doc: MISUMI's post-assembly insertion nut (HNTF6) for its 6 series, 8 mm slot, M5. Hold: MISUMI gives a tightening torque, not a pull.
name: slot-nut-8-misumi-m5-drop-in

slot.rule: Made for MISUMI's 6 series (slot width 8 mm)
slot.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-622, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_621.pdf

thread.rule: Thread M5, one of the sizes the table lists (M3, M4, M5, M6)
thread.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-622, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_621.pdf

nut_kind.rule: Put in through the opening and turned a quarter turn: a rhomboid with its corners cut at 15 degrees
nut_kind.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-622, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_621.pdf

length.rule: Along the slot once turned: 8 on the drawing
length.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-622, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_621.pdf

width.rule: Across the slot once turned: 15 on the drawing, its corners cut at 15 degrees so it turns
width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-622, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_621.pdf

height.rule: The body under the lips: E = 5.5 in the table (T = 6.3 overall)
height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-622, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_621.pdf

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening, dimensioned on the drawing
tongue_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-622, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_621.pdf

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step: the drawing's overall height less the body's
tongue_height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-622, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_621.pdf

nut_entry.rule: Post-assembly insertion: put in through the opening anywhere along the slot
nut_entry.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-622, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_621.pdf

material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-622, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_621.pdf

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its T-nut in an 8 mm slot (M6) at 4000 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m5 thread set (ISO 898-1)
